# Third-party notices

The grammars in this directory are copies of other projects' files, kept
verbatim (see [README.md](README.md) for each source and revision). Their
licenses allow copying them, on the conditions below. They are test data:
galop's own code does not include them, and the code galop generates contains
nothing from them beyond what the grammar a user gives it describes.
